}}'''Levito''' is a quest-exclusive NPC.

Before becoming a composer for the [[Troupe of Fools]], he was once the former Chief Musician of the [[Order of the Deep]] before volunteering to board the [[Pilgrim's Sail]] to seek musical inspirations and freedom. He is the brother of [[Message in a Bottle|Nannerl]] and former co-worker of [[Franciscus]]. It is unknown if both party is aware of his survival. 

After completing [[What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing]], he will request Rover's aid which unlocks [[Whimpering Wastes]].
